title: Camelias Mod
description: This mod adds some visual effects for server "Camelias"
body:
This mod adds several visual effects for the Camelias server:

- Earthquake (camera shake)
- Vignette
- Sky color changes
- Blur effect

All of these effects can be triggered by our server plugin.

 Why are we publishing it on Modrinth?

 So players can verify that the mod is safe and does not contain any malware or  viruses.
